title: Multimodal Person Concept Model for Person Identification under Varying Observation Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2611.17802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Service robots in domestic and office environments must identify users to provide personalized services based on their preferences and previous interactions. This is challenging because only a few observations may be available for learning, while observation conditions change owing to appearance, environmental noise, and utterance content. To address this challenge, this study proposes a multimodal person concept model that learns person concepts from a small number of observations, without person labels, and enables robust identification under changing conditions. The model employs a nonparametric Bayesian generative model based on the Chinese restaurant process and integrates visual, acoustic, and linguistic features extracted using Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) and Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), followed by principal component analysis (PCA). translated_title: 多模态人物概念模型：面向变化观测条件下的人员识别
translated_abstract: 家庭和办公室环境中的服务机器人必须识别用户，才能根据其偏好和之前的交互提供个性化服务。这极具挑战性，因为可用于学习的观测样本可能很少，而且观测条件会因外观变化、环境噪声和话语内容不同而改变。为了应对这一挑战，本研究提出了一种多模态人物概念模型，该模型能够从少量观测数据中学习人物概念，无需人物标签，并能在变化的条件下实现鲁棒的识别。该模型采用基于中餐馆过程（Chinese restaurant process）的非参数贝叶斯生成模型，整合了通过对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）和对比语言-音频预训练（CLAP）提取并经主成分分析（PCA）处理的视觉、声学和语言特征。研究在八种条件下对六名参与者进行了评估。
tldr: 本研究提出一种基于非参数贝叶斯生成模型的多模态人物概念模型，融合CLIP和CLAP提取的视觉、声学与语言特征，在少量无标签观测下实现变化观测条件下的鲁棒人员识别。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a multimodal person concept model based on a nonparametric Bayesian generative model integrating visual, acoustic, and linguistic features via CLIP and CLAP, enabling robust person identification under varying observation conditions from a few unlabeled observations.
